title: Respiratory Therapeutics
description: Medical record documentation, physician orders, EMR workflows, therapeutic respiratory gases, medical gas storage and delivery, oxygen delivery devices, humidification systems, medication delivery devices, aerosol therapy, controlled breathing, hyperinflation therapy, airway clearance, flow metering, air-oxygen blending, cylinder duration, Heliox delivery, oxygen concentrators, and module exam preparation.

lessons.title: Electronic Medical Records & Medical Record Entries
lessons.description: Common medical abbreviations, patient medical record elements, respiratory documentation, physician and verbal orders, Five Rights verification, and EMR hard stops.

lessons.title: Oxygen & Mixed Gas Therapy
lessons.description: Therapeutic respiratory gases, gas storage and delivery systems, cylinder safety, regulators, flowmeters, blenders, oxygen and Heliox duration calculations, Heliox flowmeter correction, and oxygen concentrators.

lessons.title: Oxygen Delivery Devices
lessons.description: O2 indications, contraindications, and hazards; low- and high-flow delivery devices; Rule of Fours; Venturi entrainment; HFNC; and oxygen analyzer calibration.

lessons.title: Humidification Delivery
lessons.description: Humidity fundamentals, ISB, active and passive humidification, HME indications and contraindications, and bland aerosol therapy with cool vs warm goals.

lessons.title: Medication Delivery Modalities
lessons.description: Aerosol particle size, MDI and spacer technique, small volume nebulizer setup and administration, ventilator medication delivery, DPI use, and SPAG indications.

lessons.title: Controlled Breathing & Airway Clearance Techniques
lessons.description: Directed cough techniques, normal cough phases, manually assisted cough, huff cough, autogenic drainage, pursed-lips breathing, diaphragmatic breathing, and mechanical insufflation-exsufflation.

lessons.title: Hyperinflation Therapy
lessons.description: IPPB indications, contraindications, disadvantages, therapeutic settings, administration procedure, incentive spirometry, and sustained maximal inspiration coaching.

lessons.title: Airway Clearance Therapy
lessons.description: Chest physiotherapy, postural drainage, percussion, vibration, PEP devices, vibratory expiratory resistance, IPV, and high-frequency chest wall oscillation.

lessons.title: Module Exam
lessons.description: Comprehensive 50-question module exam covering respiratory documentation, gases, oxygen delivery, humidification, medication delivery, controlled breathing, hyperinflation therapy, and airway clearance, plus a focused therapy review exam covering goals, indications, and contraindications.
